outline: 本課程旨在闡述專案工程規劃與控制之系統架構，主要介紹各種專案規劃與控制之方法及專案管理方法，內容包工程專案管理方法，專案工期規劃與控制，專案成本控制方法，專案資源管理，專案風險整合管理，專案品質管理，及專案人力及目標管理等介紹。
schedule:
1. Introduction to Project Management
2. Introduction to Construction Project Management
3. Project Integration Management
4. Project Scope Management
5. Project Time Management
6. Project Cost Management
7. Project Quality Management
8. Project Human Resource Management
9. Project Communications Management
10. Project Risk Management
11. Project Procurement Management
12. Project Safety Management
13. Project Environment Management
14. Project Financial Management
15. Project Claim Management
16. Project Case Study (1)
17. Project Case Study (2)
18. Final Project Report
assessment:
1. Quizzes (20%)
2. Assignments (30%)
3. Midterm Report (20%)
4. Final project presentation (5%) and final project report (25%)
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

2. Construction Extension to PMBOK (2000 Edition)
